metadata.source: U.S. Census Bureau ACS 5-Year Data Profiles & Passaic County 2026 Certified Rolls

zipCodeComparison.neighborhoodsIncluded: Passaic Park Historic District, Downtown Main Ave & Civic District, Eastside & Dundee Island District, Botany Border & South Passaic
keyFindings: Certified composite property tax rate is 4.258%, with an equalization ratio of 49.62%.
Public education represents 41.2% of property taxes, while municipal operations account for 42.5%.
Average residential assessment is $210,885, producing an average annual tax bill of $8,979.48.

neighborhoods.name: Passaic Park Historic District
neighborhoods.character: Prestigious enclave of Victorian and Tudor estates, center-hall colonials, and quiet park-like residential lanes
neighborhoods.description: Historic residential enclave featuring architectural landmarks, Orthodox Jewish cultural institutions, and high-value single family properties.
neighborhoods.taxDynamic: Anchor residential ratable zone with individual property tax bills exceeding $16,000 annually.

neighborhoods.name: Downtown Main Ave & Civic District
neighborhoods.character: Historic commercial corridor, City Hall, retail shops, and dense multi-family residential blocks
neighborhoods.description: Dense urban core surrounding Main Avenue retail corridor, convenient to NJ Transit commuter rail and municipal offices.
neighborhoods.taxDynamic: Intensive reliance on state formula school aid to offset limited commercial ratable expansion.

neighborhoods.name: Eastside & Dundee Island District
neighborhoods.character: Waterfront parkway neighborhood along Passaic River with two-family homes and historic textile mill lofts
neighborhoods.description: Textile canal-adjacent working-class neighborhood experiencing park revitalizations along Dundee Island Park.
neighborhoods.taxDynamic: High tenant density where municipal tax rates significantly affect cost of living.

neighborhoods.name: Botany Border & South Passaic
neighborhoods.character: Residential district bordering Clifton's Botany Village with cape cods and multi-family homes
neighborhoods.description: Southern gateway connecting Passaic to Clifton, providing accessible entry-level homeownership.
neighborhoods.taxDynamic: Close integration with Clifton retail markets; benefits from shared infrastructure corridors.

equityAnalysis.summary: Passaic City maintains a certified residential tax roll across its neighborhoods.

keyTakeaways.title: Property Tax Burden & Household Income
keyTakeaways.detail: In Passaic City, homeowners pay an average of $8,979.48 annually in property taxes, consuming approximately 16.57% of median household income.

keyTakeaways.title: Equalization Ratio & Revaluation Balance
keyTakeaways.detail: With an equalization ratio of 49.62%, assessed values average ~49.62% of current true market values, establishing the basis for certified county tax equalization.

keyTakeaways.title: School District vs Municipal Levy Split
keyTakeaways.detail: Local education represents 41.2% of the total tax bill, municipal government absorbs 42.5%, and Passaic County claims 16.3%.
